text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
Drawn by lively voices, we headed into the shopping district, and...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my... A flea market?
I see, no wonder there are so many people.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh? The one over there is—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I knew it! It's McQueen-chan and the others!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ines-san! Good day. Are you out shopping?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all.
I'm just helping out at the flea market here!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"They have a pretty wide variety of stuff,
so you can find some real hidden gems~."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My goodness...!
They're really selling quite a lot.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Picture books, dolls, accessories...
Hehe, it's like being inside a toy box.
choice_data_list: Since we're here, shall we go take a look?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure...!
Then, by all means...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Okay! Take your time looking around.
If you spot something you like, don't hesitate to let me know!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hmm.
They are all so wonderful, I hardly know where to look.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Trainer?
Is there anything that catches your eye?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I've read that book as well.
Every single dish in it was so elegant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Could you be cooking with this, by any chance?
choice_data_list: Could you give it a taste test?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it would be my pleasure!
Though I am just a little picky when it comes to taste, you know.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah! Have you decided on what to buy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I had a wonderful encounter!
Please wrap that one over there for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe♪
Flea markets are not to be underestimated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Wha-?! Where on earth
were you keeping something like that...?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ah—! That's the very last one!
It's super popular with families with kids.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Well... I was surprised when she brought it over out of the blue, though... Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I sympathize with your mental fatigue...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: So? Thinking of buying this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer? Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let's think it over once more.
One more time, carefully and thoroughly...

Overwhelmed by Mejiro McQueen's pressure,
I gave up on buying it.
